pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with predominantly rounded edges and smooth pixel transitions. Patch size is largest on the central flank and decreases in scale towards the ventral and posterior margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial network forming a continuous graph. Intersections are primarily 3-way and 4-way junctions. Pathway thickness is variable, with wider corridors observed between primary flank patches and narrower connectivity towards the extremities.
